title: Formal power series ring in finitely many variables
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $n\geq0$. The ring $R[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]$ of formal power series in $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ over $R$ is the set of families $(a_E)_{E\in\mathbf N^n}$ of elements of $R$, written $\sum_Ea_Ex^E$ with $x^E=x_1^{e_1}\cdots x_n^{e_n}$, with coefficientwise addition and the product $(\sum_Ea_Ex^E)(\sum_Fb_Fx^F)=\sum_G(\sum_{E+F=G}a_Eb_F)x^G$ (finite inner sums); it is a commutative $R$-algebra via $r\mapsto rx^0$. For $n=0$ it is $R$.
